newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 20.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Foreign minister John Chang makes secret visit to Europe
Traders ask government to review policy of investment caution toward China
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan takes fifth place in East Asian Games, winning eight gold, 22 silver, 19 bronze medals
On first anniversary of inauguration, President Lee Teng-hui cancels street sweeping program to visit military, police departments and senior citizen home
LIBERTY TIMES - Chinese-Taipei men's basketball team takes gold, beating South Korean host by one point
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Chiao Tung Bank scales down release of shares to keep government holding at 60 pct
Communications ministry to take back military-occupied low frequency radio channels
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Nationalist party might mobilise its investment companies to boost local bourse during first anniversary of President Lee Teng-hui's inauguration
Foreigners may be allowed to make limited investments in local commodity market
